start.description:
Start datetime of the time range. The start date is inclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2010-01-01T00:00:00' (everything starting from '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

end.description:
End datetime of the time range. The end date is exclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2011-01-01T00:00:00' (everything before '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

_size.description: length of this time-info in intervals. I.e. size of the timeseries this info represents.

_isAligned.description: true if time range is aligned with interval.

filter.description:
Filter expression to specify which obj instances should be processed/evaluated.  Filters follow the same rules as those in
{@link FetchSpec#filter}.

offset.description: Offset to use for paged evaluation.  Indicates the first computed result to return. Default is 0 (first).

limit.description:
Maximum number of results to return (starting from {@link offset}).  If there are results than were requested, only those will be returned.  If there are
additional results beyond what was requested, then {@link EvaluateResult.hasMore} will be set to true.

Default is to evaluate 2000 Objs. -1 evaluates all all.

ids.description: List of ids to evaluate for.

title: Specification provided to a call to {@link Persistabale.tsEval}.
name: TSEvalSpec
